newsitem.title: USA: Day Runner sees Q2 EPS of $0.63-$0.68.
newsitem.headline: Day Runner sees Q2 EPS of $0.63-$0.68.

text.p: Day Runner Inc said it expects to report sales for the second quarter ending December 31, 1996 of $34 to $36 million, compared with $40.1 million for the same quarter of last year.
It said it expects this lower sales level will result in earnings per share of $0.63 to $0.68, compared with $0.75.
It said said sales were negatively affected primarily by lower than expected sales to Wal-Mart and inventory tightening by certain other large customers.
It said problems with restocking of displays continued to hold down sales, particularly in December.
It said it expected to correct these problems within the next few months.

The company said it will launch several new products in the June quarter, including a line of organizers and refills featuring the popular The Far Side(R) cartoons of Gary Larson, a line of executive accessories and the Home Manager, a line of organizing products aimed at today's busy mothers.
